subject: Compliance & security add-ons pricing for Mediledger POC
messages:
From: Sara Kline <sara.kline@mediledger.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@mediledger.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Inquiry: Compliance/security add-on pricing for Mediledger POC

Hi Vanessa,

We are kicking off a short POC to validate model accuracy and latency for a patient-facing workflow. Before we proceed we need a firm understanding of the pricing for the compliance/security add-ons your team offers:

- Audit logs: we need 2 years of retention and event-level exports for audits.
- KMS/HSM integration: customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) + HSM-backed key ops.
- Data residency: ability to pin workloads to US-only or EU-only regions.
- HIPAA support: attestation and controls; roughly what the ongoing fee looks like.

Estimate: ~20M prompt+response tokens/month during the POC (spiky). We have a limited budget for the POC and will expand to a pilot if economics look good. Can you provide a line-item quote and any discounting options for an annual commit? Also please attach any SOC2/HIPAA artifacts or the path to request them.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Kline
Head of IT & Procurement
Mediledger Health

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Kline <sara.kline@mediledger.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inquiry: Compliance/security add-on pricing for Mediledger POC

Hi Sara — great to hear from you and excited to support the POC. High-level pricing and options below; attaching a compact quote (RI_Compliance_Pricing_v1.pdf) and a redlineable Master Addendum (MAA_template.docx).

Option A — POC (monthly, no commit)
- Audit logs (1-year retention default): $1,200 / month. 2-year retention: $2,400 / month. Includes event export and on-demand exports in NDJSON.
- KMS / HSM (BYOK support): $3,000 / month + $0.02 per 1k key ops. HSM-backed key storage incurs a one-time onboarding of $2,500.
- Data residency (pinning to region): $1,500 / month per region (US or EU).
- HIPAA support (controls & attestation access): $5,500 / month (includes quarterly compliance reviews and prioritized support).

Estimated POC (20M tokens/mo): add-ons above are independent of token usage; tokens will be billed on standard generation rates (we can provide those separately).

Option B — Annual committed pilot (12-month commit, 15% bundle discount)
- Apply 15% off the combined monthly add-on fees above for a 12-month commit.
- One-time onboarding credit of $5,000 if you sign within 30 days.

Notes and exclusions:
- SOC2 / HIPAA artifacts: we can provide an SOC2 Type II bridge letter and redacted control evidence under NDA; production-level HIPAA BAAs available with Private deployment.
- SLA: standard SLA included; enterprise SLA upgrades available for additional fee.

Next steps: happy to run a tailored pricing worksheet if you can confirm target committed token throughput (or a 12-mo spend target). If you have specific procurement constraints (PO process, contract countersign timelines), share that and we’ll align.

Attachments: RI_Compliance_Pricing_v1.pdf, MAA_template.docx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Mediledger negotiation strategy

Quick internal note — Sara pushed for annual commit options. Proposal to present to Mediledger:

- Offer a 20% discount on the HIPAA add-on for a 12-month commit (instead of 15%).
- Add 3 months free of the 2-year audit log tier (move to 2-yr retention with first 3 months waived).
- One-time onboarding credit: $10k (to waive their initial HSM onboarding fee).
- Require a minimum committed token baseline: 12M tokens/month (they estimated 20M spiky; we can size at 12M guaranteed).

Rishi — can you confirm whether the 2-year retention export is acceptable from a security perspective and whether we need any extra controls for BYOK onboarding? Marissa — confirm the financial impact and whether $10k onboarding credit sits in approval.

If we can present this by EOM we maintain momentum.

-V

From: Sara Kline <sara.kline@mediledger.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@mediledger.com
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance & security add-ons pricing for Mediledger POC

Vanessa, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few follow-ups after reviewing with our security and procurement teams:

1) The HIPAA fee at $5.5k/month is higher than we budgeted. For a 12-month commit we are looking for something closer to $3,850 / month (30% off) or an equivalent credit structure across the first 6 months.
2) For KMS/HSM we need clarity on key separation and proof of HSM usage (can you share the HSM vendor and attestation?). Also request that the one-time onboarding fee be reduced or credited back if we commit for 12 months.
3) Audit logs: 2-year retention is critical. Could you offer a trial window where the first 4 months are on us and then billing starts on month 5? That helps us with initial budget timing.
4) We also need SOC2 Type II evidence and a BAA draft; we can sign an NDA for sensitive artifacts.

If you can meet (1) HIPAA to $3,850/mo for 12 months, (2) waive the HSM onboarding fee, and (3) provide 4 months free on the 2-year audit log tier, we can move to an accelerated procurement review and aim to issue an LOI next week.

Regards,
Sara

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Kline <sara.kline@mediledger.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance & security add-ons pricing for Mediledger POC

Hi Sara — appreciate the clear asks and the path to LOI. We spoke with security and finance and can move on the following as a one-time, pilot-focused concession: 

Agreed commercial terms (pilot -> committed annual pilot):
- HIPAA: $4,125 / month for 12 months (25% discount off list).
- KMS / HSM: waive the one-time onboarding fee; ongoing KMS fee $3,000 / month + $0.02 per 1k key ops. We will provide an attestation from our HSM partner and a redacted diagram of key separation under NDA.
- Audit logs (2-year retention): first 4 months free, billing starts month 5 at $2,400 / month. Includes exports and CSV/NDJSON delivery.
- Onboarding credit: $7,000 applied to services / professional services line.
- Commitment: 12M tokens/month committed for 12 months (we will tier overage pricing for spikes).

We will produce a revised quote and a DocuSign-ready amendment (RI_Compliance_Pricing_v2.pdf) — link to the draft envelope: https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/0a1b2c3d4e5f. We can also provide SOC2 Type II bridge letter and start NDA exchange for HIPAA artifacts.

If this looks acceptable I can drop the revised quote into DocuSign and share the MAA redline for your legal. We will mark this as a time-limited pilot concession valid for 21 days from today.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
